title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Newcastle upon Tyne - £80,000 - £100,000

Join a successful and growing financial services business where data plays a key role in driving investment and business decisions. Following continued investment in its technology and data capabilities, the team is looking for a Data Engineer to help build and enhance a modern cloud-based data platform.

Working with technologies including Databricks, Python and SQL, you'll be responsible for developing scalable data pipelines, improving data quality and delivering trusted data solutions used across the organisation. You'll collaborate closely with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders, helping shape the future of the company's data estate while working on projects that have genuine visibility and impact.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in Data Engineering
  • Strong SQL and Python skills
  • Hands-on Databricks experience
  • Experience building and maintaining complex data pipelines
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement

Why Apply?

  • Work on business-critical data initiatives
  • Modern cloud and data technologies
  • Collaborative, highly skilled team
  • Genuine opportunities for progression and development

This is an exciting time to join a business that continues to invest heavily in its data and technology capabilities. With interviews already underway, this role is expected to move quickly, so apply now to be considered and avoid missing out on the opportunity to play a key role in the next stage of their data journey.
